1.e4 g6 2.Nc3 Bg7 3.f4 c5 4.Nf3.strategy: Develops the knight and covers d4 and e5, the squares Black's c-pawn and bishop fight for. White keeps the centre solid while the f-pawn and e-pawn hold space for the later attack.

1.e4 g6 2.Nc3 Bg7 3.f4 c5 4.Nf3 Qa5.strategy: An early queen sortie that puts the queen and the g7 bishop both on the c3 knight, which the b2 and d2 pawns hold, and also eyes a2. Black takes the initiative on the queenside, though the queen may lose time if White harasses it.
1.e4 g6 2.Nc3 Bg7 3.f4 c5 4.Nf3 Qa5.name: Pterodactyl Defence: Austrian, Grand Prix Pterodactyl
